title: File:Medieval boar livery badge (FindID 530737).jpg

title: File:Gedenktafel Heilige Krone von Ungarn, Rathaus, 2026 Kunszentmárton.jpg
desc: Town Hall. Built in 1813. In 1807, Kunszentmárton was granted market town status, and accordingly, the first two-story, classical-style Town Hall was built between 1811 and 1813. The administrative building was inaugurated on November 7, 1813. The building is characterized by a 3+1+3 window division
